sam: quick follow-up on cross-path evasion for the quota migration. want a tight mitigation plan and a rollback path.
reena: goal: no double-billing and detect clients trying both endpoints to game quotas.
sam: plan: transparent bridge shim that forwards to ledger and tags requests with X-Q-Map header; ingress dedupes by request-id and emits dedupe_rate metric.
reena: pseudocode for ingress dedupe:
```
if req.headers['X-Q-Map']:
  if seen(req.id): return 202_NO_CHARGE
  mark_seen(req.id)
  forward_to_ledger()
else:
  forward_to_legacy()
```
diego: partial-failure case: if legacy returns success and ledger times out, treat legacy as source-of-truth for the window and enqueue ledger write for retry. nightly reconciler compares ledgers and surfaces mismatches.
sam: abuse detection: maintain a cross-path sketch keyed by client-fingerprint. rule: if cross-path QPS > 3x rolling baseline AND burst credits disabled -> route to probation pool and alert.
reena: ledger will optionally return X-Quota-Abuse: <0-100> header; ingress uses score>60 to trigger probation routing.
